sn48.22:1.3: The faculty of femininity is described as “feminine moves, feminine appearance, feminine ways, feminine desires, feminine voice, and feminine adornment”, which may be observed and desired in oneself or another ([an7.51:2.2]()). It is thus the *expression* of femininity, the *performance* of it, rather than biological sex. The faculty of masculinity is the opposite. | The faculty of life is the life force ([sn47.9:2.5.]()), which, when cut off, means death ([dn22:18.10](), [mn9:22.5](), [pli-tv-bu-vb-pj3:3.10]()). It has both material and mental aspects ([vb5:11.1]()).
